Ravi: Heads-up 1: BlueHarbor Labs finished interview recording and sent draft case study. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/blueharbor-draft (please review). They want an embargo until May 21 for PR coordination.
Jo: Thanks. We need logo permission, three short hero quotes, and confirmation theyre ok with publishing a short architecture diagram.
Tess: Legal flagged "architecture diagram" as potential IP leakage. Ask them to submit a redacted diagram or a high-level block diagram only.
Marco: I'll request the redacted diagram. Also ask for speaker names and bios for the webinar.
Nia: Webinar ask: BlueHarbor wants a co-presenter slot for their Head of ML and prefers a morning slot (PDT). Are we ok with May 22 morning?
Ravi: Tentatively yes. Press embargo to May 21 09:00 PT should work. We need to align PR and social. press-bot: Press embargo registered: BlueHarbor case study embargo until 2026-05-21T09:00:00-07:00.
Sam: For registration routing: please create SFDC campaign "BlueHarbor-Case-May22" and push registrants to HubSpot. Also add UTM params for email drip.
Jo: Copy. Proposed UTM baseline: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=blueharbor_case. Share with content team.
Tess: Legal follow-up: get a signed media release + a checkbox for consent to claim "reduced inference cost" and to share anonymized latency percentiles. If they won't sign for concrete numbers, we can use qualitative language.
Marco: BlueHarbor suggested quote options in the doc: 1) "Redwood helped us scale inference more predictably." 2) "We cut inference spend by nearly half." 3) "Tail latency dropped significantly, improving customer-facing throughput." Which do we prefer?
Nia: Prefer specific but only with signed consent. If they approve #2 we can use "nearly 50%". Otherwise use #1 or #3.
Ravi: Also note: BlueHarbor is a partner with WidgetCorp; PR team says confirm there are no co-marketing conflicts.
Sam: Add an attendee opt-in for follow-up sales outreach. Map MQL criteria: attended >=40% or watched recording.
Jo: Creative needs: one banner image, 2 screenshots (dashboard + integration flow), company logo, and a 30s testimonial clip. Can BlueHarbor provide the clip?
Marco: They're open to recording a 30s quote. I'll ask and collect assets.
Tess: Reminder 1: redact any customer-specific contract numbers or system endpoints in screenshots.
press-bot: Calendar event created: BlueHarbor Case Webinar  (co-hosted) on 2026-05-22 09:30 PDT. Invites sent.
Nia: Will co-host with Product Marketing + Solutions Engineer. Need to lock speaker slides by May 18 for PR review.
Ravi: Draft social copy in doc. Priority channels: LinkedIn, Twitter, Newsletter. Also ask partner comms team to loop in WidgetCorp if relevant.
Jo: I'll draft the blog and short-form social copy. Please drop edits inline.
Sam: For tracking: create Marketo program + integrate with SFDC campaign. I'll handle the Marketo side.
Marco: BlueHarbor uploaded a signed release (blueharbor_media_release.pdf) and a redacted diagram to the doc. They approved "nearly 50%" language and agreed to the 30s clip.
Tess: I'll do a quick legal sweep tonight. If anything problematic, we'll default to qualitative phrasing and anonymized percentiles.
Nia: AV check : Do we need booth or studio to record live? I recommend an AV dry-run May 20. Who can own?
Ravi: I'll schedule a dry-run on May 20 10:00 PT. Add it to the event.
Jo: Next steps checklist: Marco collect assets + clip (by May 14); Tess legal signoff (by May 18); Creative deliver banner + slides (by May 18); Sam Marketo/SFDC mapping (by May 16); Nia lock speakers and dry-run (May 20).
Marco: Sending asset request to BlueHarbor now. Will post updates here. Thanks team.
